title: ResCCOM island.yaml schema v0
description: RFC-0005 D1/D2 identity+allocations and RFC-0006 D3 spatial/policy data. See island-init/TASKS.md 2.1-a.
$comment: `signature` is intentionally NOT required here: an unsigned file is a valid draft/lab document. island_init.checks enforces that a production-profile island must be signed, and island_init.crypto verifies the signature cryptographically when present.

profile.description: lab may use test PLMN/IMSI/keys; production must not (see island_init.checks).

id.description: Short slug, unique within the registry (RFC-0005 D2).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. XA-XZ (user-assigned) is reserved for lab/dev use.

node_classes.description: node-hw/ reference classes this island runs. 'dev' = a developer machine, not any node-hw class (WBS 2.1 node OS image not built yet).

signing_key_fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of signing_public_key (RFC-0005 D1), for humans/logs. Generated by island-init new.

signing_public_key.description: Base64 raw Ed25519 public key. The actual key island_init.crypto verifies `signature` against -- the fingerprint alone isn't enough to verify offline.

address.description: 3.3-b: this island's own WireGuard tunnel address (CIDR, e.g. '10.99.0.1/24') -- distinct from `endpoint` (how peers reach it) and from every `allocations`/`node` prefix.

imsi_block.description: IMSI prefix this island issues subscribers under (mcc+mnc+island number, RFC-0005 D2). Lab uses the reserved 3GPP test block.

dns_zone.description: CoreDNS zone / Matrix server_name suffix. Local-only alias, never routed between islands (CLAUDE.md).

node.description: 3.3-a: node-internal addressing (container/NF plumbing on this island's own host) -- distinct from `allocations`, which is registry-assigned and shared with the outside world. Every hardcoded node-internal address in island_init/templates/ derives from this.

internal_base.description: A /16 (or wider) private block this island's core_net (and any future node-only subnet) is carved from. render v0 takes the first /24 of this block as core_net -- see island_init/render.py NODE_IP_OFFSETS. The lab value (10.10.0.0/16) is today's core_net (10.10.0.0/24) unchanged (golden rule).

log_level.description: 3.3-c v2c: lab-only override for every NF's logger.level (Open5GS lib/app/ogs-init.c reads this string case-insensitively: none/fatal/error/warn/info/debug/trace). Optional, defaults to 'info' -- rendering omits the `level:` line entirely at the default so an unset/default island renders byte-identical to before this field existed (golden rule).

share.description: Opt-in per item; defaults to false (RFC-0006 D5).

peers.description: 3.3-b: the WireGuard overlay allow-list (RFC-0003 D2) -- islands this one authenticates and routes to. Empty by default (no island trusts a stranger); an entry here is the rendered result of an association-to-association trust ceremony, never auto-discovered.

endpoint.description: host:port the peer's wg-overlay listens on.

node_internal_base.description: Peer's `node.internal_base` -- routed over the tunnel so this island's core can reach the peer's NFs.

services_prefix.description: Peer's `allocations.services_prefix` -- routed over the tunnel alongside node_internal_base.

plmn.description: 3.3-c v2 (RFC-0003 D1 amendment): peer's `allocations.plmn` -- distinct-PLMN roaming via SEPP/N32 needs the visited AMF's access_control and this island's SEPP N32 peer table to know it, since it isn't derivable from anything else already in this entry.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the rest of this document (island_init.crypto.canonical_payload). Written by island-init new; not required at schema level -- see the root $comment.

earfcn.description: LTE only; null for nr cells.

arfcn.description: NR only; null for lte cells.

tx_power_dbm.description: Null for a ZMQ/rfsimulator virtual rig — no real transmit power exists to report (CLAUDE.md 'don't invent RF numbers').
